text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, good morning, F-chan! To tell you the 
truth, I felt destiny calling the moment I 
woke up this morning! Let's go for a run 
right now!"

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: —Understood. I will be right there.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
(...5:20 AM. Epi-san woke up exceptionally 
early today, didn't she?)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Is it good, Eff? Eat up! Here, open wide: 
say 'aah.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Around lunchtime, I headed to the 
cafeteria only to find Epiphaneia 
relentlessly feeding carrots to Efforia 
for some reason.
choice_data_list: Why go out of your way to feed them...?
Why go out of your way to feed me...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Because I felt destiny telling me I 
had to feed Eff!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
. I feel like I can give training my all 
now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And a few days later. As I was preparing 
for afternoon training...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Eff! The co-op run is canceled! Let's 
switch to indoor training for today!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: ? I'd like to hear your reason.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Because I felt it was destiny!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
—Understood. Let us move to the training 
gym, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few more days later. While inspecting 
new training equipment next to Efforia by 
chance,

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's Eff! Hey, let's go do an 
eating challenge! I just ran into a poster 
of destiny!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: I apologize. —I must decline for now.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Why's that!?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Today's routine isn't finished yet. ...If 
I stop now, I would be turning my back on 
my destiny.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate Epi-san's invitation, I 
really do. However, right now...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
........Got it! Then let's go for the 
competitive eating challenge after 
training!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It won't mean a thing unless Eff feels 
happy about it! Fate-wise, that's 
definitely the better way to go anyway!
choice_data_list: Oh, didn't get pushed around today, huh?

Oh, didn't get pushed around today, did 
you?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It won't mean a thing unless Eff feels 
happy about it! Fate-wise, that's 
definitely the better way to go anyway!
choice_data_list: Oh, didn't get pushed around today, huh?

Oh, didn't get pushed around today, did 
you?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
? I don't recall being pushed at all, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I haven't pushed today either! Not 
Efforia!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though their words and actions were polar 
opposites, they were somehow alike. They 
truly were a curious pair.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Could it be you hear the voice of 
destiny too!?
choice_data_list: No, that's not what I meant……

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Eff! Let's take this Trainer along for the 
big eating contest too!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Yes, understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Explaining that I had important work to 
attend to, I somehow managed to avoid 
tagging along for the eating contest.
